recentItems.title: Alexandre Tharaud plays Fauré: Cantique de Jean Racine, Op. 11 (Transcr. For Piano Solo)
recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: Ice Dance (From: "Edward Scissorhands")
recentItems.description:
Danny Elfman’s iconic "Ice Dance" from "Edward Scissorhands", brought to life by world-renowned cellist Gautier Capuçon. In this rich arrangement, the cello's deep, expressive warmth captures the fairytale wonder, bittersweet romance, and magical nostalgia of Tim Burton's classic film score.

recentItems.title: Anneleen Lenaerts plays Ravel: Ma mère l'Oye, M. 60: I. Pavane de la Belle au bois dormant
recentItems.description:
In this delicate arrangement, Anneleen Lenaerts (harp), Adam Walker (flute), and Timothy Ridout (viola) weave a shimmering, fairy-tale atmosphere, depicting a princess drifting into a 100-year slumber. The trio captures the serene stillness of Ravel's "Sleeping Beauty" with refined elegance and impressionistic colour, transforming the masterwork into an intimate dialogue.
